card.name: Scattered numbers and odd name pieces
card.fires_on: No single word type. It fires on the first digit of a number before mL, kg or kHz, and on odd spots like the middle of a street name or a comma in a table.

modes.label: Digits before units
modes.description: A digit that starts or sits inside a number just before mL, kg or kHz in dosing tables or specs.

modes.label: Inside place names
modes.description: The end piece of a street or place name in an address.
modes.example: Cnr Hawkesbury Rd & Hains<<worth>> St, Westme

card.plain: It has no clear single job. It responds to numbers before units and to a few unrelated spots in the text.
